hypothesis: The current linear disease logits may underrepresent angular class separation and multiple within-disease modes. Compare normalized cosine disease prototypes, one versus two centers per disease, and two explicit positive-target margins.
controls: Same frozen320+448 DINO features, train-only normalization, region attention, MLP width256,dropout0.6, optimizer, disease auxiliary and cross-patient contrastive losses as milestone5. Only the final disease-logit parameterization changes.
margin_policy: Margins apply only to positive disease targets in the training auxiliary loss. Inference and three-class probabilities use ordinary cosine similarities without labels or margins. Unknown subtype labels are ignored.
inference_scale: Learned exp(log_scale), clamped4 to32, initialized10. Each disease uses the largest similarity among its centers. Disease probabilities are summed into the exact three requested classes.
outer_cv: Original3patient folds, separate inner stopping patients and3seeds per fold; all6configs receive CV regardless of validation score.
development_gate: Require improved original patientCV macro-F1 and nondecreasing validation macro-F1 versus milestone5. Passing models still require newly fixed repeated-patient confirmation.
reference_policy: Milestone5 is the fixed unnormalized classifier control for this geometry experiment. The separately frozen Gaussian candidate is preserved. No external result is read to choose configurations.
external_test_policy: No external images, labels, predictions or metrics are used for fitting, early stopping, comparisons or selection.
